installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry, Consumer<Boolean>) - Method in class io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer.AddonInstaller
As AddonInstaller.installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry), but invokes onComplete on the main thread when finished (true = success), so a menu can re-render with in-GUI feedback.
installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry, Consumer<Boolean>, Runnable) - Method in class io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer.AddonInstaller
As AddonInstaller.installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry, java.util.function.Consumer), but also invokes onProgress on the main thread as bytes arrive, with a fraction in [0,1] (or -1 for an indeterminate stage), so a menu can render a live progress bar for the clicked entry.
installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry, Consumer<Boolean>, Runnable, AddonReleaseService.ReleaseInfo) - Method in class io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.core.guide.installer.AddonInstaller
As AddonInstaller.installRelease(Player, AddonCatalog.Entry, java.util.function.Consumer, Runnable), but installs a specific release primaryOverride for entry (rather than the latest), powering the version picker / downgrade.

LoreBuilder - Class in io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.utils
Deprecated.
Building lore in code is exactly what the unified lore system replaces. Stat/usage lines (energy, speed, material, hunger, range, radioactivity, the RIGHT/CROUCH hints) belong in languages/en/items.yml as stats/usage block entries, where they are localizable and follow the fixed Type/Description/Stats/Usage structure. Do not add new LoreBuilder calls; migrate existing ones into the item's en/items.yml entry.
